# NBAA - National Business Aviation Association

> > The National Business Aviation Association (NBAA) is the leading organization representing business aviation, providing advocacy, safety standards, professional development, and industry events.

NBAA serves the business aviation community through programs like the International Standard for Business Aircraft Operations (IS-BAO), the Professional Development Program (PDP), and major industry events including the Annual Meeting & Convention. Led by executives including Ed Bolen and Dan Hubbard, NBAA advocates for regulatory policy with the FAA and provides training, certification, and resources for aviation professionals.

## Key Topics

- Business Aviation
- IS-BAO (International Standard for Business Aircraft Operations)
- Professional Development Program (PDP)
- NBAA Annual Meeting & Convention
- Aviation Safety Standards
- FAA Regulatory Advocacy
- Schedulers & Dispatchers
- Aviation Training & Education
- Flight Department Management
- Aviation Maintenance
- Charter Operations
- EBACE (European Business Aviation Convention & Exhibition)
- Aviation Scholarships
- Business Aviation Policy
